Compute the maximum number of decimal places per group

Source: R/get_numdec.r
ks_get_numdec.Rd

For each group defined by by, determines the maximum number of decimal digits observed in var (after rounding to 4 decimal places) and joins the result back as a new column NUMDEC.

Usage

ks_get_numdec(data, var, by)

Arguments

data

A data frame or tibble.

var

Character string naming the numeric column to inspect.

by

Character vector of grouping column names.

Value

data with an additional integer column NUMDEC giving the group-level maximum decimal count.

Details

The decimal-digit count is derived by formatting the rounded value with format(scientific = FALSE), stripping trailing zeros, and counting characters after the decimal point. NA values in var are ignored when computing the group maximum.

Examples

d <- data.frame(
  grp = c("A", "A", "B", "B"),
  val = c(1.1, 2.34, 3.0, 4.567)
)
ks_get_numdec(d, "val", "grp")
#>   grp   val NUMDEC
#> 1   A 1.100      2
#> 2   A 2.340      2
#> 3   B 3.000      3
#> 4   B 4.567      3
